subject: MSA redline call — need to reschedule and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@brightwell.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightwell.com
Date: 2026-10-03T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request to push MSA redline call

Hi Kimberly,

Apologies for the late ask — our legal lead just got pulled into an executive review and won’t be available for the scheduled MSA redline walkthrough this afternoon. We’re hoping to shift the call to later this week so we can have both procurement + legal in the room.

Possible windows on our side:
- Thu 10/07: 10:00–11:00 PT or 15:00–16:00 PT
- Fri 10/08: 09:30–10:30 PT

I’ve attached the latest Brightwell-marked MSA (Brightwell_MSA_markedup_v3.pdf) and a short vendor evidence list. If you need us to split the session (legal redlines first, evidence review after), we can do that.

Thanks for understanding — we want to make sure key stakeholders are present.

Best,
Sara Taylor
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightwell Health
attachments: Brightwell_MSA_markedup_v3.pdf, vendor-evidence-list.xlsx
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@brightwell.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to push MSA redline call

Sara —

Totally understood. Thanks for sending the marked-up MSA. We can accommodate a later slot this week. Proposed plan and windows (Redwood attendees in parentheses):

Option A — Consolidated session (45–60m):
- Thu 10/07, 10:00–11:00 PT (Kimberly, Marissa, Rishi) — good for a joint redline + evidence Q&A

Option B — Staggered (two 30m blocks):
- Thu 10/07, 15:00–15:30 PT (legal redline; Kimberly + Rishi)
- Fri 10/08, 09:30–10:00 PT (implementation/evidence; Marissa + engineering SME)

If you expect additional contract team members to attend, Option B lets us keep the legal discussion focused and the evidence handoff separate.

Marissa — can you pull the vendor evidence checklist from the shared drive and validate the owners? Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CmxMSA-evidence
Rishi — I’ll need a 2–3 slide summary of any service-level deviations we should highlight to Brightwell (tokenized latency targets, data residency notes).

I can do Option A or B; please confirm which window they prefer and I’ll send an updated invite + a brief agenda.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success (Contracts)
Redwood Inference
attachments referenced: vendor-evidence-list.xlsx

Subject: internal: Brightwell — evidence owners + redline prep (short)

Short internal note (threaded to keep context):

Marissa — please confirm the evidence matrix and flag any gaps by EOD Tue 10/05. Priority items: SOC 2 report access, encryption key rotation logs, retention policy summary. If any items are held by Infra, escalate to Hari (cc’d on our internal tracker).

Rishi — can you draft the 2–3 slide exceptions summary today? Focus on the limited latency SLA carve-outs for dedicated pools and the proposed contractual fallback (auto-failover to hosted). I’ll merge into the agenda.

We’ll set the meeting as a video call; I’ll send the invite once Brightwell confirms which option they prefer.

—Kim
